settings.auto_resize_tip: Automatically resizes the window to match the image when a file is loaded.\nHas no effect while the window is maximized.
settings.background_color_popup_tip: Background color for popups such as page numbers.\nCombine with transparency to adjust readability.
settings.background_color_tip: Background color of the image viewer. Shown in margins when the image is smaller than the window.\nClick the button to pick a color.
settings.cache_archive_metadata_description: Cache archive file structure information in memory\nfor faster access. (For future feature expansion)
settings.cache_archive_metadata_tip: Keeps archive structure information in memory so reopening is faster.
settings.cache_benchmark_confirm_detail: The measurement uses CPU, memory, and storage, and takes from a few dozen seconds to a few minutes.\nResults are inaccurate if other heavy work is running or tabs with large files are open.
settings.cache_benchmark_confirm_text: Measure the best image loading settings for this PC.
settings.cache_benchmark_progress_note: EzCo cannot be used while measuring. Cancelling leaves your settings unchanged.
settings.cache_benchmark_result_detail: Page wait p95 {p95}ms / max {max}ms / memory increase {memory} / measured in {elapsed}s
settings.cache_benchmark_result_restart_note: A new worker count takes effect after restarting EzCo. Nothing is saved until you press Apply or OK.
settings.cache_benchmark_stage_cache: Measuring cache size and prefetch pages
settings.cache_image_loader_workers_description: Number of workers each viewing tab uses for prefetching. More workers are not always faster, and they increase CPU, memory, and I/O usage. Load can multiply across several open tabs, so Automatic is recommended. Changes take effect after restarting EzCo.
settings.cache_measure_best: Measure the best settings for this PC...
settings.cache_measure_best_runtime_override: Image loading settings are fixed by a startup option, so a measured result cannot be applied as is.
settings.cache_measure_best_tip: Loads real images to pick the combination that suits this PC. It takes from a few dozen seconds to a few minutes, and nothing is saved until you press Apply or OK.
settings.cache_memory_limit_description: Set the memory cache size for images.\n(e.g., 256MB, 1GB, 2.5GB)
settings.cache_memory_limit_tip: Maximum memory used to keep decoded images. A larger value is not always faster; beyond what prefetching reaches, only memory usage grows.\nExamples: 256MB, 1GB, 2.5GB\nGuide: raise it for high-resolution books in several tabs, otherwise the default is enough.
settings.cache_prefetch_pages_description: Number of pages to prefetch around\nthe current page for caching.
settings.cache_prefetch_pages_tip: How many pages before and after the current page to preload (1–50).\nA larger window is not always faster. When prefetched pages are evicted before you reach them, they are decoded again and page turns get slower.\nGuide: around the default of 5. Raise it only if you often skip pages.
settings.cache_recommended_memory_unknown: Physical memory could not be detected, so the safer value is recommended.
settings.cache_recommended_settings: Recommended for this PC: cache {memory_limit} / prefetch {prefetch_pages} pages / workers {workers}
settings.cache_restore_recommended: Restore the recommended settings for this PC
settings.cache_restore_recommended_tip: Fills the form with the values chosen from this PC's CPU and memory. Nothing is saved until you press Apply or OK.
settings.data_location_custom_warning: Note: A shared folder can let other users read or change the settings.
settings.data_location_exe_warning: Note: Other users on this PC may be able to read or change those settings.
settings.data_location_not_writable: The selected folder may not be writable. If the next start fails, choose another location.
settings.data_location_restart_note: This change takes effect the next time you start EzCo.
settings.data_location_tip: Shared across all profiles. Changes apply the next time you start EzCo.
settings.debug_log_enabled: Debug logging has been enabled. Log files will be created in the logs folder on next startup.
settings.debug_mode_description: Enable debug features.\nDebug log files will be created in the logs folder when the application starts.
settings.debug_mode_tip: Writes detailed logs to the logs folder. Intended for troubleshooting.\nLeave this off for normal use. Log files are created on the next startup after enabling.
settings.drop_opens_new_tab_tip: Choose whether dropped files or folders open in the current tab or a new tab.\nHow multiple files are grouped is also controlled by the archive and folder options below.
settings.fit_to_window_minimum: Limit minimum scale to full screen (100%)
settings.fit_to_window_minimum_tip: Limits downscaling to 100% (actual size).\nSmall images are not enlarged; only large images are scaled down.
settings.fit_to_window_tip: Scales the image to fit inside the window.\nWhen off, the image is closer to actual size and you can pan overflow.
settings.font_color_tip: Text color for popups such as page numbers.\nClick the button to pick a color.
settings.font_family_tip: Font used for on-viewer text such as page numbers and popups.\nType to filter the list. A restart may be required.
settings.font_size_tip: On-viewer text size (8–64).\nA restart may be required.
settings.font_style_tip: Weight and style of the selected font.\nAvailable choices depend on the font.
settings.gesture_threshold_tip: Distance required to confirm a mouse-gesture direction (20–100 pixels).\nSmaller is more sensitive; larger reduces accidental gestures.
settings.image_move_sensitivity_tip: How fast the image moves when dragged (0.5–4.0).\nLarger values move farther with the same gesture.
settings.invalid_cache_size_warning: Invalid cache size entered. Reverting to default value (256MB).\n\nCorrect format: 256MB, 1GB, 2.5GB etc.
settings.invalid_optimize_threshold_warning: Invalid optimization threshold entered. Reverting to default value (50MB).\n\nCorrect format: 50MB, 100MB, 2.5GB etc.
settings.keep_archive_handles_description:
⚠️ Warning: When enabled, archive files and folders will be constantly locked,
preventing folder and file movement/deletion.
Disabled recommended: Avoids file locks but may slow down
loading performance for large archives.
settings.keep_archive_handles_tip: Keeps archive and folder handles open. Reloads may be faster, but files stay locked and cannot be moved or deleted.\nLeaving this off is recommended.
settings.language_plugin_layout_note: Text inside plugin sidebars stays the same until you restart. Menus and sidebar titles update immediately.
settings.language_tip: Changes the display language. Menus and sidebar titles update immediately. Text inside plugin sidebars stays the same until you restart.\nSystem default follows the OS language.
settings.max_history_count_tip: Maximum number of items kept in the history menu (1–99).\nOlder entries are removed when the limit is exceeded.
settings.maximize_on_startup: Always maximize the window on startup
settings.maximize_on_startup_tip: Always maximize the window on startup, even if it was a normal size last time.\nTakes priority over window-state restore. This is not fullscreen.
settings.mouse_repeat_acceleration_start_tip: How long to hold before the repeat interval starts accelerating (50–500 ms).
settings.mouse_repeat_initial_delay_tip: Wait before repeating page turns while a mouse button is held (50–500 ms).\nLarger values reduce accidental repeats at the start of a press.
settings.mouse_repeat_min_interval_tip: Shortest repeat interval after acceleration (10–100 ms).\nSmaller values repeat faster.
settings.open_archives_in_own_tab: Open each archive in its own tab
settings.open_archives_in_own_tab_tip: When enabled, each dropped or multi-selected archive opens in its own tab.\nWhen disabled, archives are merged with images and folders as pages in one tab.
settings.open_folders_in_own_tab: Open each folder in its own tab
settings.open_folders_in_own_tab_tip: When enabled, each folder opens in its own tab.\nWhen disabled, folders are merged with images as pages in one tab.
settings.open_last_file_on_startup_tip: Automatically open the last viewed file at startup.\nThis uses the last history entry and is separate from session restore.
settings.optimize_large_images_tip: Downscales huge images for display to reduce memory use.\nTurn this off if you need full original detail.
settings.optimize_max_resolution_description: Maximum resolution (pixels) for resizing images during optimization.\nAspect ratio is preserved.
settings.optimize_max_resolution_tip: Maximum long-side size in pixels when optimizing (1000–10000).\nAspect ratio is preserved.
settings.optimize_threshold_description: Images larger than this size will be automatically resized to\nreduce memory usage. (e.g., 50MB, 100MB)
settings.optimize_threshold_tip: Images larger than this file size are optimized.\nExamples: 50MB, 100MB
settings.profile_description: Profile feature allows you to manage history and bookmarks separately.
settings.profile_runtime_override_description: The current profile is temporarily set by startup arguments.\nThe config.yaml settings will not be changed and will return to the original settings on the next startup without arguments.
settings.profile_runtime_override_message: Profile settings are overridden by command line arguments.
settings.reset_settings_confirm:
Do you want to reset all settings to default values?
This operation cannot be undone.
settings.restart_required: Some settings such as language and font will be applied after restarting the application.
settings.restore_page_on_reopen: Restore page when reopening same file
settings.restore_page_on_reopen_tip: When reopening the same file, resume from the page where you left off.\nApplies to files that remain in history.
settings.runtime_override_tooltip: This setting is overridden by command line arguments at startup.\nPlease modify the startup arguments to change this setting.
settings.save_window_state: Restore size, position, and maximized state on startup
settings.save_window_state_tip: Saves window position, size, and maximized state on exit, and restores them on the next startup.\nIf “Always maximize on startup” is enabled, that setting takes priority.\nThe restored normal size is remembered separately while maximized.
settings.show_error_log: Show error log when an error occurs
settings.show_error_log_description: Shows a stack-trace dialog for plugin setup/callback/load failures and unhandled host exceptions. The text can be copied.\nLeave this off for normal use.
settings.show_error_log_tip: Shows a stack-trace dialog when an exception occurs. Intended for troubleshooting. Leave this off for normal use.
settings.spread_selected_as_axis: Spread from the selected page (going back from page 2 shows page 1 alone)
settings.spread_selected_as_axis_tip: In spread mode, the page selected with the slider or list becomes the first page of the spread (N), and the neighbor is N+1.\nGoing back from page 2 shows page 1 as a single page.
settings.spread_toggle_preference_tip: Chooses right or left spread when toggling between single-page and spread.\n“Keep previous selection” reuses the last spread direction.
settings.transparency_tip: Popup background opacity. 0 is fully transparent, 255 is opaque.

ui.archive_disabled_description: When archive support is disabled globally, individual archive type settings are ignored.\nArchive files with unchecked types will not be opened.
ui.archive_disabled_message: Archive files are disabled in settings.\nChange the loading method in Settings → File Settings.
ui.archive_file_moved:
Archive file has been moved or deleted
'{path}'
